scope: Ordinary Remote configuration producer 0x1969430 to MessageInputSliderPreset fields

id.value: Model.id plus effort identifier; the preset begins at array element +0x18 after its reasoningEffort payload

modelTitle.value: Model title helper result; normalization is separately partial

speed.value: Optional Speed none; enum has three no-payload cases standard/fast/ultrafast and typeref is Speed?; this field differs from current configuration speed

conclusions: The ordinary Remote producer preserves the model effort array. A six-marker reference does not establish a fixed six-level UI.
Preset title and effortTitle are distinct fields. This producer fills title and leaves effortTitle absent.
Ordinary Remote presets are unlocked and not marked default in this producer. Shared picker locked behavior belongs to a wider consumer scope.
The selected configuration speed is supplied separately. Do not infer per-preset speed from the screenshot or current speed setting.
limitations: Static layout and store mapping, no target execution or visual acceptance.
Swift native representations are artifact-local, not a frontend/backend wire schema.
Model title normalization, shared alternate preset producers, target frame consumers and gestures have independent evidence scopes.
